marks the preceding statement as quoted or concluded
affirms the truth of the statement

items.question: How certain is the absence of spiritual attainment for one who neglects the āgama path?
premises: One who neglects the āgama path has no spiritual goal.
The statement of this absence is declared to be true.
The truth of this statement is emphatically repeated.
No doubt exists regarding this absence.
items.inference: Therefore, the lack of spiritual attainment for such a person is absolutely certain.
items.plain_english: For him there is no goal—this is true, true; there is no doubt.
